title: Highmoor Rising
author: Ines Coldharbour
blurb: Petra Dunmore, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
